remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. Nothing on back. Pink Shell with seaweed and blue background. Title given by Rosalind Irvine. Note: O'Keeffe thinks done ab. 1938." The stretcher accompanying the works once housed 'Dark Abstraction,' a 1920 painting (lost or destroyed) that was no. 42 in the 1923 Anderson Galleries exhibition. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1938. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1938. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Pink Shell with Seaweed

credit_line: San Diego Museum of Art, Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Norton S. Walbridge (1978.088)
description: A smooth, pink spiral seashell occupies the center of the composition. Behind the shell, a strip of green seaweed, riddled with holes, stretches across the image. The objects contrast with a blue and white background.
title: Pink Shell with Seaweed
